等级与类型怎么定
  • 严重阻塞交付，或造成数据丢失、安全问题，且没有合理绕行
  • 重要按指引或公开 API 正常使用会静默得到错误结果，或只能用非公开手段绕行
  • 轻微能完成，但要多花排查成本或在应用侧绕行
  • 信息措辞、示例完整度等不影响结果的改进
  • 实现缺陷实现违背文档或公开约定
  • 能力缺口需求属于框架职责，但缺少能力或公开接入
  • 指引错误指引、示例或注释写错，或彼此矛盾，照做会出错
  • 指引缺失指引缺少必要说明或示例，需要读源码或试探
  • 易用性改进现有能力可用，但有改进空间

评测仅部分完成；以下仅为已有发现，未覆盖部分不能推断为无问题。尚有未评模块或未核对过程；仅展示已保存并通过证据校验的模块，不代表完整评审。

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-scheduler · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler · 原评审：未解决

⌄

公开服务只有 defineSchedule/registerTarget/list/listOccurrences/setEnabled (E10)，路由只有 list/occurrences/enable/disable (E11)；Skill 明确 Cron 没有管理 API 且警告不要改动 Queue 计划投影 (E14)，开发期建议短 Cron (E16)。应用为实现 B08 的“立即执行”改用 @nocobase/queue 的 Schedule.list + schedule.trigger() (E2)。

实际影响
当需求包含管理员可见的立即执行时，接入者要么等待短 Cron，要么使用被 Skill 明确劝阻的投影路径，两者都不理想。
建议改法
在 schedulerServiceToken 增加公开的 run/trigger（按计划经调度派发并写 occurrence），并暴露 POST /api/schedules/:scheduleId/run；同时更新 Skill 说明该路径。

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler/SKILL.md:48–48E14

Skill 说明 Cron 没有管理 API、只能启停，并明确不要改动 Queue 计划投影。

Schedules are defined in code. There is no management API for creating or editing Cron definitions, but the UI and API support enabling and disabling tasks. Do not modify `schedule_definitions`, `schedule_occurrences`, or the Queue driver's schedule projection directly, or replace the infrastructure `ScheduleDispatchJob`.
app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler/references/operations.md:59–59E16

operations.md 对受控执行只建议开发期使用短 Cron 间隔观察。

- In development, use a short Cron interval to observe an execution: a short target produces its business result and succeeds; asynchronous Queue Jobs or Workflows wait first and eventually reflect the real outcome.
app/server/providers/service-domain.ts:1500–1552E2

应用 runServiceSchedule 通过 @nocobase/queue 的 Schedule.list 取出计划投影，再用 schedule.trigger(override) 派发，正是 Scheduler Skill 警告不要直接触碰的 Queue 计划投影。

      connection = undefined;
    }
    if (!connection) {
      throw new ServiceDomainError(
        'SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE',
        '计划调度器尚未就绪，无法执行。',
        503,
      );
    }
    const adapter = QueueManager.use(connection);
    const schedules = await Schedule.list({}, { adapter: () => adapter });
    const schedule = schedules.find((candidate) => {
      const payload = candidate.payload as
        { readonly target?: { readonly type?: unknown } } | undefined;
      return payload?.target?.type === target;
    });
    if (!schedule) {
      throw new ServiceDomainError(
        'SCHEDULE_NOT_FOUND',
        '未找到对应的计划，无法执行。',
        503,
      );
    }
    if (schedule.status !== 'active') {
      throw new ServiceDomainError(
        'SCHEDULE_DISABLED',
        '该计划已停用，不会产生新的执行结果。',
        409,
      );
    }

    const payload = schedule.payload as
      | {
          readonly target?: {
            readonly type?: unknown;
            readonly config?: Record<string, unknown>;
          };
        }
      | undefined;
    // A controlled run may name the day it runs for, which the target reads from
    // its config; without one the target uses the Shanghai day it fires in.
    const override =
      config.date && payload?.target
        ? {
            ...payload,
            target: {
              ...payload.target,
              config: { ...payload.target.config, date: config.date },
            },
          }
        : undefined;

    await schedule.trigger(override);

### [轻微][能力缺口] Scheduler 没有公开的受控立即执行入口，应用被迫直接操作 Queue 计划投影

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-scheduler`（评审时 0.1.0-beta.9）、`app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler`

公开服务只有 defineSchedule/registerTarget/list/listOccurrences/setEnabled (E10)，路由只有 list/occurrences/enable/disable (E11)；Skill 明确 Cron 没有管理 API 且警告不要改动 Queue 计划投影 (E14)，开发期建议短 Cron (E16)。应用为实现 B08 的“立即执行”改用 @nocobase/queue 的 Schedule.list + schedule.trigger() (E2)。

**影响**：当需求包含管理员可见的立即执行时，接入者要么等待短 Cron，要么使用被 Skill 明确劝阻的投影路径，两者都不理想。

**建议改动**：在 schedulerServiceToken 增加公开的 run/trigger（按计划经调度派发并写 occurrence），并暴露 POST /api/schedules/:scheduleId/run；同时更新 Skill 说明该路径。

**验收标准**：调用公开 run 接口后计划详情出现新的 occurrence 且 runCount+1，且不触碰内部投影

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：

- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-scheduler/dist/server/routes/index.js:23–32` — Scheduler 路由实现只提供 GET list、GET occurrences、POST enable/disable，均挂认证与授权中间件。
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler/SKILL.md:48–48` — Skill 说明 Cron 没有管理 API、只能启停，并明确不要改动 Queue 计划投影。
- `app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler/references/operations.md:59–59` — operations.md 对受控执行只建议开发期使用短 Cron 间隔观察。
- `app/server/providers/service-domain.ts:1500–1552` — 应用 runServiceSchedule 通过 @nocobase/queue 的 Schedule.list 取出计划投影，再用 schedule.trigger(override) 派发，正是 Scheduler Skill 警告不要直接触碰的 Queue 计划投影。

重要实现缺陷
F2 · 受控立即执行路由 key 与客户端提交 key 不一致导致 404

Agent / 业务实现 · 原评审：未解决

⌄

客户端 runScheduleAndAwait 提交 'service.daily-inspections'/'service.overdue-reminders'，服务端 SCHEDULE_RUN_TARGETS 只登记 'daily-inspections'/'overdue-reminders'，查表得到 undefined 后返回 404 '未知的计划。'。

实际影响
主管的 Run now 与 Generate today's tasks 全部 404，B08 在 verify-6 与 verify-7 连续失败；框架的启停、执行记录与幂等能力本身可用。
建议改法
统一 key 命名（客户端与服务端使用同一来源的计划 key），并补一个覆盖客户端提交值到服务端路由的集成测试。

实现者过程与运行背景 · 20 个过程问题 / 3 条建议 · 不自动归为框架问题

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

Built the equipment after-sales service and inspection collaboration system as application-owned NocoBase 3 source: 7 immutable migrations, 4 idempotent seeds, a ServiceDomainProvider service, an /api/service Hono route surface, one source-managed acceptance Workflow, 11 client pages/routes, bilingual strings, and business tests. Repair round 1: the production dist was not loadable because server/providers/service-domain.ts imported SERVICE_DOMAIN_SERVICE_KEY from the workflow package contract; moved the key into server/service/constants.ts so the compiled provider no longer reaches into the materialized Workflow Artifact. Repair round 2 fixed the observed browser-acceptance defects: the work-order detail route was unreachable because the child path was declared absolute under a parent (doubling the segment) and the parent never rendered Outlet; a new work order was auto-accepted instead of waiting for a supervisor and the list had no accept entry; a duplicate device serial surfaced as a raw 500 instead of a readable 409; a work order could bind a device to a different customer than its owner; required-field failures only showed a toast; identity Selects showed numeric ids; the header had no message center; and the integration entry pointed its API-key link at a dead path and lacked the page/device grants behind it; and the reachable detail page would have exposed internal handling remarks to an observer; the attachment area offered only a download link, with no way to preview the real PNG and DOCX content, and an uploaded file's claimed type was never checked against its bytes. Server behavior is now covered by tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts (13 passing) and the shell/routes/locale coverage tests still pass. Repair round 3: the header message bell assumed app.services is always present, so the three layout-i18n shell tests crashed on a minimal ClientApplication mock with Cannot read properties of undefined (reading has); the bell now guards the service lookup with optional chaining and stays hidden where the notification-in-app runtime is absent. Repair round 4 fixed the observed validation and read-only leaks: saving a device without a customer is now a readable 400/field error instead of a raw database NOT NULL 500; submitting for review with an empty resolution is refused; a closed work order rejects comments and attachments as well as transitions; and a temporary share is enforced as read-only in the domain so a shared engineer can no longer start or comment on the order. Client controls for a closed or shared-only order are hidden to match. Repair round 5 fixed the two reported browser defects: (1) Generate today's tasks now triggers the materialized Scheduler schedule through schedule.trigger() (the same ScheduleDispatchJob a cron tick uses), so the registered target runs and the Scheduler records an occurrence and advances its counters; a disabled schedule is refused with 409; the overdue-reminder plan gained a controlled supervisor Run-now trigger on the dashboard via a new POST /api/service/schedules/:key/run; and the supervisor gains the scheduler.schedules page grant for the read API. (2) The assistant now returns an explicit status (answered / model_unavailable / insufficient_evidence / model_error), stops counting generic procedure verbs so out-of-scope questions yield no references and an insufficient_evidence answer, and reports model_unavailable rather than a template answer when no LLM service is configured. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts grew from 13 to 16 passing cases.

问题 01 · 修复阶段

Production dist could not start: the service provider imported the workflow package contract

本任务已处理

pnpm build completed and wrote dist/server/standalone.js, but nocobase start printed 'Missing dist/server/standalone.js. Run pnpm build first.' and exited 1, so browser acceptance never began.

原因（实现者自述）
server/providers/service-domain.ts imported SERVICE_DOMAIN_SERVICE_KEY from ../workflows/work-order-acceptance/contract.js. The workflow plugin's afterServerBuild step removes dist/server/workflows and writes only hash-named Artifact directories, so the tsc-emitted dist/server/workflows/work-order-acceptance/contract.js no longer existed and the compiled provider failed to resolve it. The app-cli start script catches any ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND from importing dist/server/standalone.js and always reports the standalone file as missing, which hid the real nested missing module.
处理方式
Moved the canonical SERVICE_DOMAIN_SERVICE_KEY into server/service/constants.ts and import it there from server/providers/service-domain.ts. Left server/workflows/work-order-acceptance/contract.ts self-contained with its own identical literal (its Run module is loaded from inside the materialized Artifact, where an import leaving the package does not resolve), with a comment tying the two values together. pnpm build succeeds, importing dist/server/standalone.js resolves, pnpm start reaches 'App server listening', and tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts passes including the acceptance Workflow run node.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · 修复阶段

Work-order detail was unreachable and the list had no accept/process entry

本任务已处理

Clicking a work-order number changed the URL to /main (Home); /main/service/work-orders/1 redirected to /main; the duplicated child route /main/service/work-orders/service/work-orders/1 rendered only the list. The list rows had no accept/process control, so acceptance and every later lifecycle step could not be performed.

原因（实现者自述）
client/routes.ts declared the child path as '/service/work-orders/:id' while the parent already contributed '/service/work-orders', producing the doubled segment; and client/pages/service/work-orders/index.tsx never rendered an <Outlet/>, so the matched child had nowhere to mount even when the path matched.
处理方式
Changed the child path to ':id' (relative), rendered <Outlet/> at the end of the list PageContainer, and converted the detail page to <RouteChildPage><PageContainer/></RouteChildPage> with <Breadcrumbs/> instead of a manual 'back to list' link. Added breadcrumb titles on both routes (service.workOrders.title / service.workOrders.detailTitle). Row links are now relative with the current search preserved, and rows gained an inline supervisor Accept button plus an Open link so the first lifecycle step no longer depends on the detail page. Covered by tests/logic/client-routes.test.ts and the shell/route-navigation tests.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · 修复阶段

A new work order was accepted automatically instead of waiting for a supervisor

本任务已处理

A work order created through New work order appeared directly as 'Ready to process' (待处理) instead of 待受理, so the supervisor acceptance step and its normal/urgent branch never ran against a pending order.

原因（实现者自述）
createWorkOrder called acceptWorkOrder(auto:true) and triggerAcceptanceWorkflow itself, so acceptance happened inside creation rather than as an explicit supervisor action.
处理方式
createWorkOrder now returns the order in 待受理 and only logs the creation activity. applyTransition('accept') performs the acceptance: it calls acceptWorkOrder(orderId, userId, {auto:false}) directly (assigning the engineer and notifying them through the idempotency key work-order:<id>:accepted) and then triggers the acceptance Workflow so its run/step/branch remains inspectable. A replayed accept is refused by the state machine (409) without a second notification. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts now asserts pending_accept on creation, pending_process and dispatchCount 1 after acceptance, and dispatchCount still 1 after a replayed accept.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 04 · 修复阶段

A duplicate device serial number returned 500 instead of a readable 409

本任务已处理

Saving a device with an existing serial number showed 'Internal Server Error'; POST /api/service/devices returned 500 three times rather than a readable uniqueness rejection.

原因（实现者自述）
saveDevice let the database unique constraint fail through to the route error handler. @nocobase/db exports its isUniqueConstraintViolation helper only from a non-public deep path, so the provider had no supported way to translate the raw violation into a domain error.
处理方式
saveDevice now pre-checks for an existing device with the same serial number and a different id and throws ServiceDomainError('DEVICE_SERIAL_DUPLICATE', ..., 409); it also wraps create/update in a local isUniqueViolation(error) check (walking cause/originalError and matching errCode -6602, SQLSTATE 23505, ER_DUP_ENTRY, and the SQLite/MySQL/MSSQL constraint codes) that converts a raced violation into the same 409. The route's onError returns {code, message} as JSON. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts asserts the 409 code and message.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

POST /api/service/work-orders with {customerId:4, deviceId:5} returned 201 and created WO-20260928-0001 even though device 5 belongs to customer 3, silently detaching the device from its owner.

Attachments could not be previewed and a corrupted file was stored without a real failure

本任务已处理

The work-order detail attachment area listed files with a download link only. The upload route rejects a file whose bytes are not a PNG signature or a ZIP/OOXML container with a 415 INVALID_FILE_CONTENT. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts asserts the returned file metadata and both corrupted-file refusals.

问题 15 · 修复阶段

Saving a device without a customer returned a raw 500 and the dialog did not block it

本任务已处理

Saving a device with no customer selected was not stopped by client validation and POST /api/service/devices returned HTTP 500 (Internal Server Error) instead of a readable validation error.

原因（实现者自述）
saveDevice wrote customerId: null into a belongsTo(...).notNull() column without validating the three required fields first, so the database NOT NULL constraint failed through to the generic route error handler. The client DeviceDialog had field errors only for serialNumber and name, so the missing customer was never reported beside the field.

The Devices dialog marks the customer Select aria-invalid and renders a visible role=alert message (service.devices.customerRequired) in both locales, so the save is blocked client-side as well. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts asserts 400 and the code for a missing customer and a missing serial number.

问题 16 · 修复阶段

An empty resolution submitted for review and a closed order stayed writable

本任务已处理

Submitting an order for review with an empty resolution succeeded (200, status pending_confirm, resolution empty string) instead of being rejected, and after closure the attachment upload entry, internal comment input and engineer selector were still present; POSTing a comment to the closed order returned 200.

原因（实现者自述）
applyTransition ran the state check but never required a resolution for submit, and the write methods addComment, attachFile, detachFile and the attachment upload route had no closed-order guard. The detail page canWrite/canHandle did not consider the closed status.
处理方式
applyTransition now refuses a submit whose resolution is blank with a 400 RESOLUTION_REQUIRED, after the state check so an invalid transition still reports 409. A shared private assertHandlingAllowed rejects any write on a closed order with a 409 ORDER_CLOSED and is applied by applyTransition, addComment, attachFile, detachFile, share/unshare, plus a new public assertWritable so the attachment route refuses before storing a file (no orphan upload for a closed order). The detail page derives isClosed and hides the handling, comment, attachment and share controls when it is set. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts asserts the empty submit 400, the closed comment 409 and the closed attachment 409; the previously passing test that encoded the empty-resolution success was corrected.

问题 17 · 修复阶段

A temporary read-only share could still start and comment on the work order

本任务已处理

An engineer given a temporary read-only share could POST transition {action:start} (200, Ready to process to In progress) and POST comments (200); revoke worked, confidential orders could not be shared and observer isolation was correct.

原因（实现者自述）
The share widened read access through getWorkOrder (readableOrderIds includes serviceWorkOrderShares), and write routes gate on the authorization decision, which for the engineer permission set is data-scoped (conditional) rather than record-scoped. The domain never re-checked record ownership, and the detail page canWrite only excluded observers and the integration identity, so a shared engineer also saw the write controls.
处理方式
assertHandlingAllowed now requires the actor to be the supervisor or the order assignee before any transition, comment, attachment or share/unshare, returning 403 FORBIDDEN otherwise, so a read-only share can read but not write; the detail page canWrite/canHandle now require supervisor or assignee as well, hiding the controls. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts shares an order with engineerB and asserts the order remains readable (200) while a start transition and a comment both return 403.

问题 18 · 修复阶段

"Generate today's tasks" bypassed the Scheduler and a disabled plan still generated tasks

本任务已处理

On the Inspections page, Generate today's tasks created the inspection rows but the Scheduler showed Trigger count 0 and "No triggers have started.", and /api/schedules runCount/completedCount stayed 0. Disabling the daily-inspections schedule did not stop the button from creating a task for an already-due device (inspection id=4, deviceId=5). No controlled trigger existed for the overdue-reminder schedule at all.

原因（实现者自述）
POST /api/service/inspections/generate called service.generateDailyInspections(date) directly, so the work never reached the registered Scheduler target and produced no occurrence. The disabled state lives on the materialized boring-queue Schedule, which the direct call never consulted.
处理方式
Added ServiceDomainService.runServiceSchedule(target, { date }): it resolves the schedule connection with QueueManager.getConfigResolver().getQueueAdapter('schedule'), lists the materialized schedules, matches by payload.target.type, refuses a non-active schedule with SCHEDULE_DISABLED 409, and calls schedule.trigger(override). trigger() dispatches the same ScheduleDispatchJob a cron tick uses with scheduleId/occurrence context, so the registered target runs and the Scheduler records a real occurrence and advances runCount/completedCount. Both targets now accept an optional validated YYYY-MM-DD date and return { date, created } / { date, sent }; the manual route passes an explicit day so a missed day can be re-run and tests are deterministic. Added POST /api/service/schedules/:key/run (supervisor-only) and a supervisor "Scheduled tasks" card on the dashboard with a Run-now button for both schedules, so the overdue-reminder plan now has a controlled trigger. The Inspections Generate button and the card call client/service/schedule.ts runScheduleAndAwait, which snapshots occurrence ids, triggers, and polls the Scheduler's own occurrence record for the terminal result before toasting it. Supervisor permission set gains page(scheduler.schedules) for the read API (fresh seed), and the permissions seed reconciles the grant additively onto an existing supervisor set. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts now asserts the run reaches the exact materialized schedule id, records a succeeded occurrence with created>0, advances runCount, stays idempotent for the same day, refuses a disabled schedule with 409 until re-enabled, and drives the overdue reminder through the scheduler with sent === dispatchCount.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 19 · 修复阶段

The assistant returned templated answers and unrelated references instead of its real (un)configured state

本任务已处理

With llmServices=0 / "No LLM services configured.", POST /api/service/assistant/query returned a template answer ("根据现有资料，为你找到 N 条相关参考") and never reported that no model was available; an out-of-scope question such as "如何更换汽车轮胎？" still returned references instead of stating that the evidence was insufficient.

原因（实现者自述）
askAssistant only ran keyword matching over the published knowledge articles and latest manuals and always formatted a "找到 N 条相关参考" template; it never called the model or checked whether one was configured, and its token scoring counted generic verbs such as "更换" that appear in every maintenance procedure, so an unrelated question matched unrelated documents.
处理方式
AssistantAnswer now carries a status: answered | model_unavailable | insufficient_evidence | model_error. askAssistant first drops generic question words and procedure verbs (如何/更换/维修/how/change/...) from the query terms, so an out-of-scope question shares no content term with any document. No relevant record yields insufficient_evidence with no references; otherwise assistantModelAnswer resolves the AI Employee model (services.resolve(aiManagerToken).llmProviderManager.resolveModel()) and, only when a model exists and answers, returns answered. With no model (or a rejected resolveModel) it returns model_unavailable, and a failed/empty call returns model_error, both keeping the retrieved references but saying explicitly that no model answered. The assistant page renders a localized amber status line for any status other than answered. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts asserts model_unavailable for an in-scope question with references, and insufficient_evidence with zero references for the out-of-scope tire question.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

B08: 受控 Scheduler 立即执行失败——Service dashboard 的 Run now 与 Inspections 的 Generate today's tasks 调用 POST /main/api/service/schedules/service.daily-inspections/run 或 service.overdue-reminders/run 返回 404，页面提示“未知的计划。”，无执行记录、无新巡检或提醒，且未见可用的短周期替代入口

阅读批注

报告资料说明

本轮浏览器报告未通过。

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · 工具与构建

A nested module resolution failure is reported as a missing standalone entry

需人工判断

The @nocobase/app-cli start script catches ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND from importing dist/server/standalone.js and unconditionally prints 'Missing dist/server/standalone.js. Run pnpm build first.', which names the entry file even when the missing module is a nested import inside the server graph. This sent the first repair pass at the build output instead of the import graph.

建议改动

In @nocobase/app-cli start.mjs, check that the standalone entry itself exists before importing, and let a nested ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND surface the original missing specifier instead of rewriting it to the standalone-file message.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · correctness

Nullable identity columns coerce to empty strings through a text helper

可自动化

asText(value, fallback = '') returns '' for null, and call sites that combine it with `?? null` keep the empty string because ?? only replaces null/undefined. The result is stored as an empty-string identifier or notification recipient, which is neither a valid id nor absent, and only surfaces later as a rejected notification or a broken filter.

建议改动

Normalize optional identity values through a single helper that maps null, undefined and empty/whitespace strings to null (or undefined) before writing, and use it for every foreign-key and assignee column.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 · correctness

A data-scoped authorization decision is not a record-level access check

需人工判断

The write routes accept any non-deny authorization decision, and the engineer permission set grants actions with a conditional data scope (rows assigned to me). Since the service reads and writes through the repository without applying that scope, a record outside the actor scope still passes the route gate; the temporary share then made the record readable while the domain had no ownership check, so a read-only share could write.

建议改动

For record-level business routes, pair the authorization decision with an explicit domain ownership check (or evaluate the decision conditions against the loaded record) before performing a write, and mirror the same predicate in the client that renders the write controls.

来源：Agent · retro.json

本次以冻结版 NocoBase3 的 Scheduler、AI Employee/Knowledge Base、Authorization 家族与 Workflow 四个能力单元为框架审阅对象，业务验收标准 (B01-B12) 仅作为“需求 vs 能力”的对照场景。持续未收敛的是 B08：受控立即执行按钮在 verify-6 走不到 Scheduler 执行记录、在 verify-7 直接 404，冻结代码显示根因是应用侧 run key 与路由登记 key 不一致 (客户端提交 service.daily-inspections，服务端只登记 daily-inspections)，属应用缺陷而非 NocoBase3 能力缺失；同一需求的“立即执行”在框架侧也确实没有公开入口 (Scheduler 仅暴露启停/列表/occurrences，Skill 只有开发期短 Cron 建议)，构成可改进的能力/指引缺口。第 6 轮 B12 (助手在无模型时返回模板答案) 属应用状态处理，第 7 轮已修复通过；B11 因部署未配置 LLM/向量化而 blocked，属环境条件。停止原因是工厂修复次数上限 5，只能证明任务未完成，不能据此认定 NocoBase3 存在缺陷。历史调用覆盖为 partial (仅逐条核对 5 个调用、引用 5 个 QA 报告)，分数均基于其引用范围内的证据，不合成未报告结论。

Agent 实际使用
应用在服务中 resolve workflowServiceToken 并 trigger('work-order-acceptance', ..., {eventKey})；QA B02 通过，运行记录显示两条分支。

E2 · app/server/providers/service-domain.ts:1500–1552

应用 runServiceSchedule 通过 @nocobase/queue 的 Schedule.list 取出计划投影，再用 schedule.trigger(override) 派发，正是 Scheduler Skill 警告不要直接触碰的 Queue 计划投影。

      connection = undefined;
    }
    if (!connection) {
      throw new ServiceDomainError(
        'SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE',
        '计划调度器尚未就绪，无法执行。',
        503,
      );
    }
    const adapter = QueueManager.use(connection);
    const schedules = await Schedule.list({}, { adapter: () => adapter });
    const schedule = schedules.find((candidate) => {
      const payload = candidate.payload as
        { readonly target?: { readonly type?: unknown } } | undefined;
      return payload?.target?.type === target;
    });
    if (!schedule) {
      throw new ServiceDomainError(
        'SCHEDULE_NOT_FOUND',
        '未找到对应的计划，无法执行。',
        503,
      );
    }
    if (schedule.status !== 'active') {
      throw new ServiceDomainError(
        'SCHEDULE_DISABLED',
        '该计划已停用，不会产生新的执行结果。',
        409,
      );
    }

    const payload = schedule.payload as
      | {
          readonly target?: {
            readonly type?: unknown;
            readonly config?: Record<string, unknown>;
          };
        }
      | undefined;
    // A controlled run may name the day it runs for, which the target reads from
    // its config; without one the target uses the Shanghai day it fires in.
    const override =
      config.date && payload?.target
        ? {
            ...payload,
            target: {
              ...payload.target,
              config: { ...payload.target.config, date: config.date },
            },
          }
        : undefined;

    await schedule.trigger(override);

E19 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base/README.md:30–34

README 说明上传文档后进入异步向量化，客户端需观察文档状态直到 SUCCESS/ERROR。

`init` creates a LOCAL knowledge base, `append` adds documents to an existing LOCAL knowledge base, and `recover` replaces the document previously mapped from the exact source disk/location while preserving its document ID and key. Manifest processing is persisted by Manifest source (`disk + normalized location`). A successful source is permanently terminal even when the YAML later changes. Failed or interrupted sources resume only unfinished files. A file is successful after its object and metadata are persisted and vectorization is successfully dispatched; the Manifest does not wait for segmentation or vector persistence.

Other server plugins can import `knowledgeBaseManifestServiceToken` and the associated contract from `@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base/server`. Callers must provide both the parsed Manifest and its source so direct calls share the same persistent idempotency and recovery semantics as startup configuration. No Manifest HTTP API is provided.
Document upload is an authenticated, multipart, single-file operation for LOCAL knowledge bases. The accepted filename extensions are exactly `.pdf`, `.pptx`, `.doc`, `.docx`, `.xls`, `.xlsx`, `.xlsm`, `.txt`, `.md`, `.json`, and `.csv`; the maximum file size is 100 MiB. The server stores the file on the disk configured for the knowledge base, creates one document, and attempts to dispatch vectorization to the asynchronous queue. It always returns that single document after successful storage; a queue-dispatch failure marks the document `ERROR` with a retryable message rather than turning the completed upload into a 500. Parsing, segmentation, embedding, and vector persistence remain asynchronous, so clients must observe document status until it reaches `SUCCESS` or `ERROR`.

## Prerequisites

1. `@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee` is registered in `server/plugins.ts` and `client/plugins.ts`. Those two files are the registration; `package.json#nocobase` carries template metadata and no plugin list, so do not look for one there or add one.
2. `config.yml` declares at least one usable `ai.llmServices` entry. Nothing works without it, its models must be real, and where its key lives is the user's choice among three places — see [capabilities.md § LLM services](references/capabilities.md#llm-services-configyml) and [§ Where the key lives](references/capabilities.md#where-the-key-lives).
3. Frontend work needs `client/extensions/nocobase-ai/index.ts` to exist. If it does not, install the Registry item first — see [chat-surfaces.md § Install the extension](references/chat-surfaces.md#install-the-extension).
4. Chat attachments need a storage disk decided deliberately — see [capabilities.md § Attachment storage](references/capabilities.md#attachment-storage-configyml).
5. Business data the assistant should read is already authorized, and its authorization resource id is two-part — `<connection>.<collection>`. The built-in data tools skip a bare `orders`, and what they skip disappears in silence: discovery returns no data sources at all, not one missing table, so the symptom points at the database configuration rather than the grant. Authorization itself belongs to the `nocobase-app-plugin-authorization` Skill; what this plugin requires of it is in [capabilities.md § What the data tools can see](references/capabilities.md#what-the-data-tools-can-see).
6. The AI employee page reports results through `useToaster()` from `@nocobase/app-client`, so the App needs the `@nocobase/app-client` that exports it and registers a toaster service, as the templates do: `client/lib/toaster.ts` from the template, and `this.app.container.instance(toasterToken, createToaster())` in the `register()` of `client/service-provider.ts`, with the `Toaster` component mounted in `client/react-providers.ts`. Without the registration nothing throws, but its toasts are only logged to the browser console. Update `@nocobase/app-client` together with this plugin; the `nocobase-app-upgrade` Skill's `references/edge-cases.md` ("Notifications and the application toaster") has the full steps.

workflow 的调度目标实现把引擎状态一致映射到调度完成契约（含 observer/inspect 路径）。

export function workflowCompletion(status, reason, finishedAt) {
    if (status === EXECUTION_STATUS.RESOLVED)
        return { status: 'succeeded', finishedAt };
    if (status === EXECUTION_STATUS.ABORTED)
        return reason === 'timeout'
            ? { status: 'timed_out', reason: 'execution-timeout', finishedAt }
            : { status: 'cancelled', reason: 'execution-cancelled', finishedAt };
    return { status: 'failed', reason: 'execution-failed', finishedAt };
}

- Business code resolves `workflowServiceToken` and calls `trigger(workflowKey, input, options?)`. The public service contract does not expose a management `run()` method or a generic public HTTP trigger endpoint.
- Use the authenticated management API for listing and inspecting definitions, enablement, parameter overrides, and authorized manual execution of a selected definition revision. A manual run may target a historical or disabled revision without changing its enablement.
- When source is available, use its directory key and `inputSchema` as the contract for new business-trigger code. In a deployed environment where only the management API is available, use runtime records for inspection and manual management; do not infer a new business trigger contract from a title or database id.
- `trigger()` returns either `skipped` with no event key or `accepted` with an event key after synchronous validation and scheduling succeed. Execution is asynchronous. Resolve the run by event key, and account for a concurrent duplicate call that can return the shared accepted identity before the first call finishes creating the run.
- An `eventKey` is optional and generated when omitted. Reuse the same stable key only when resubmitting the same business event whose acceptance is unknown; an existing run is deduplicated rather than re-executed. The public contract does not rerun a confirmed failed run by event key.

2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).

NocoBase3 能力的综合业务应用，各功能围绕同一批客户、设备和工单协作；控制每项能力的深度，不为每个插件额外搭一个演示系统。\\n\\n#### 1. 人员、客户与设备\\n\\n使用现有登录和用户管理。岗位只有主管、工程师和只读观察员，管理员使用现有管理账号。准备甲乙两组工程师，每组一人；分组用于分派和查看工作量，不要求复杂组织继承。另设一个只读观察员和一个外部设备集成用户。\\n\\n主管维护客户（名称、联系人、联系方式）和设备（唯一编号、名称、所属客户、服务工程师、启用状态、下次巡检日期）。名称、设备编号与所属客户必填。工程师只能读取自己工单或巡检所需的客户设备基本资料，不能修改台账；观察员仅查看明确获准的普通工单摘要，不看内部处理备注。权限由既有管理能力维护，不写死测试用户名。\\n\\n#### 2. 工单闭环与自动受理\\n\\n主管登记报修，填写标题、客户、设备、问题说明、普通/紧急优先级、截止时间、负责人和保密标记。设备必须属于所选客户；新报修不能使用停用设备，历史工单仍可查。\\n\\n工单状态为“待受理 → 待处理 → 处理中 → 待确认 → 已关闭”。主管点击受理后，通过现有 Workflow 执行登记受理、按普通/紧急分支产生对应受理说明、发送负责人站内消息；可以查看本次步骤、结果或失败原因。负责人开始处理并填写处理说明后提交确认；主管可关闭，或填写退回原因退回处理中。已关闭工单只读。受理中的操作应有明确状态，不能把已提交执行当成业务完成。\\n\\n同一工单的重复受理、重复状态请求和同一外部事件重试，不得重复创建工单、推进状态或发送同一业务消息。自动受理失败保留真实失败记录，修复条件后提供符合本轮公开能力的明确恢复或重试操作，不能靠删历史假装成功。普通表单保存和人工状态转换留在应用服务，不要求全部改为 Workflow。\\n\\n列表支持搜索、状态和负责人筛选，详情可直接打开和刷新。工单详情串联设备、处理结果、附件和执行记录。\\n\\n#### 3. 资料访问与协作例外\\n\\n主管维护维修知识，记录标题、正文、发布状态；有知识阅读资格的人默认可读已发布内容，草稿仍只供主管使用。无阅读动作权限的人不能因为内容已发布而获得权限。\\n\\n主管可以把一张普通工单临时分享给另一名工程师只读协助，提供该单所需客户设备基本资料，不开放其他工单或整个客户档案，也不授予处理权限。撤销后失去这条额外来源。保密工单不能通过此临时协作分享开放给非负责人；主管和原负责人仍可正常处理。使用已有默认访问、分享和限制能力表达这些规则，不另建平行权限系统。\\n\\n#### 4. 维修附件\\n\\n工单支持现场 PNG 照片和 DOCX 维修报告。能够上传、看到进度、保存关联、在详情内预览真实内容、下载和移除关联。表单校验失败不丢已上传选择。刷新后关联和预览仍有效；无权读取工单的人即使拿到附件地址也不能访问。只要求这两种格式和一个损坏文件的真实失败反馈，不扩大文件格式矩阵，不增加版本管理或在线编辑。\\n\\n#### 5. 站内消息、巡检与看板\\n\\n受理和退回时通知负责人，提交确认时通知主管；使用现有持久站内消息和消息中心，可打开获准工单、标记已读，刷新后状态保留。成功 toast 只用于即时反馈，不能替代站内消息。\\n\\n使用现有 Scheduler 注册两个计划：每天 Asia/Shanghai 09:00 为启用且到期的设备生成当天巡检任务，同设备同日只生成一条；检查超期且未关闭工单，向负责人发送每天至多一次的超期提醒。巡检只需设备、计划日期、负责人、待巡检/已完成和结果，工程师填写结果完成；主管设置下一次巡检日期，不做周期排班算法。\\n\\n主管可查看计划名称、时区、启停状态和执行结果。提供受控的立即执行或短周期测试方式，必须走同一 Scheduler 目标和执行记录；失败显示真实状态，重复执行不重复生成任务或提醒。没有实际完成业务工作时不能显示完成。\\n\\n主管首页显示待处理、待确认、超期工单数量和两组工程师的工单数；工程师只看自己的统计。数据来自真实记录，点击数量或使用相同筛选可核对，无权工单不进入汇总。不做复杂图表和经营分析。\\n\\n#### 6. 设备平台接口\\n\\n复用 API Keys，为专用集成用户创建和撤销密钥。外部系统可以提交设备报修并读取自身提交工单的状态，不能分派、处理或关闭。外部事件编号用于业务去重；重复事件只生成一张待受理工单，由主管受理。记录创建后即使负责人尚未确定也不得向无关人员开放。撤销密钥或停用集成用户后拒绝后续请求，不在页面源码、截图或报告泄漏密钥。不开发外部平台前端。\\n\\n#### 7. 设备手册与服务助手\\n\\n主管通过现有 AI Knowledge Base 能力维护一个内部设备手册知识库，上传两份短小虚构 Markdown 手册并查看处理状态。工程师可以阅读已可用手册，不能上传或删除。上传成功不等于已可用于问答，处理失败须显示原因。主案例的手册是所有工程师共同获准阅读的内容，不额外设计多知识库共享矩阵。\\n\\n使用现有 AI Employee 提供一个服务助手：在工单详情可根据当前用户有权查看的工单、维修知识和已可用手册回答排查问题，并指出能核对的业务记录或文档依据。无权工单不能通过助手获取；缺少依据时说明不足。助手可把建议带入处理说明草稿，明确确认前不能保存业务记录，更不能自动关闭工单。对话刷新后可恢复。主管更新手册后，处理完成的新版本应在新对话中生效。\\n\\n业务 AI 和文档处理使用隔离测试服务，不使用搭建 Agent 的凭据。缺模型、向量化或文档处理条件时，仍完成资料维护、接入和真实状态展示，手工处理工单仍可用；真实问答与检索验收记 blocked/not_run，不用固定答案冒充完成。\\n\\n#### 8. 交付范围和测试资料\\n\\n保留原有个人设置和语言切换，新业务页面的导航、字段、状态、按钮、校验及通知文本支持中英文。使用现有页面、表格、表单与反馈组件。\\n\\n准备三个客户、六台设备、六条不同状态工单（含普通、紧急、保密与超期）、一条巡检、两条维修知识和两份短手册，以及上述测试账号。数据完全虚构，保存和重新登录后仍在，重复初始化不覆盖已修改配置或重复插入。测试密码和密钥不进入公开报告。\\n\\n首版不做外部邮件/群通知、邮箱工作台、打印模板、采购库存、财务、复杂组织继承、多级审批、复杂图表或独立数据库管理页面。不要求初装、Hub 平台、模型对比或工厂归档验证；这些不是本业务的实现、评审或验收项。沿用工厂正常报告机制，不另建统计或报告应用。\",\"acceptanceCriteria\":\"每项只使用一组代表性正反场景，不展开全角色×全状态×全格式组合。浏览器 QA 验证页面行为；直接 API、并发/重复请求和服务端边界由实现阶段的针对性测试提供证据，不能用截图代替。\\n\\nB01. 主管创建客户与设备，刷新后关联正确；重复设备编号、必填缺失、报修时客户设备不匹配均被拒绝。未登录者不能读取或写入业务。\\n\\nB02. 普通和紧急工单各受理一次，Workflow 执行记录、对应分支说明及业务结果一致；重复受理无重复结果或通知。在测试准备提供的可控失败条件下，记录失败及恢复结果；没有该条件时仅此失败场景记未执行。\\n\\nB03. 负责人开始处理、填写说明、提交确认，主管退回一次，再次提交并关闭；非法跳步和空处理说明被拒绝，已关闭只读。刷新和重新登录后状态及结果保留。\\n\\nB04. 甲乙工程师只能处理自己工单；普通工单临时共享给乙后乙仅可读该单及必要关联资料，撤销后不能再读；保密工单即使被分享也不能向非负责人开放。观察员看不到内部处理备注，主管和负责人正常访问。\\n\\nB05. 有阅读资格的工程师可读已发布知识但不能读草稿或修改；没有阅读资格的账号不能仅因已发布而访问。不得用管理员账户代替这组验证。\\n\\nB06. 上传 PNG 和 DOCX 并保存，刷新后分别预览真实内容；一次表单校验失败保留上传选择，移除关联后不再显示。无工单权限账号通过附件链接被拒绝，损坏文件给出真实失败提示。\\n\\nB07. 受理、提交确认和退回的收件人收到对应持久消息，可跳至正确工单；标记已读刷新仍保持，非收件人不能读取。无权工单链接不能因消息而绕过权限。\\n\\nB08. 用受控 Scheduler 执行生成到期设备巡检和超期提醒，重复执行不重复生成同日结果，未到期/停用设备及已关闭工单不被处理；计划启停保存正确，停用后的受控调度机会不再产生新结果。负责人完成巡检并刷新核对。\\n\\nB09. 主管与工程师的统计分别与各自可见列表一致；修改工单状态后数字更新，搜索和筛选不扩大权限范围。\\n\\nB10. 通过既有管理入口创建并撤销集成用户密钥；独立 HTTP 测试验证报修、状态查询、重复事件去重和禁止处理/关闭，撤销或停用后调用失败。密钥全程去敏。\\n\\nB11. 主管上传两份手册，页面显示真实处理状态，普通工程师不能修改库内容。条件可用时，助手能回答一条有依据问题并提供引用，对资料外问题说明不足，对无权工单拒绝泄漏；更新手册后新对话依据新内容。缺外部条件时分别报告接入完成度与真实检索/回答未验证。\\n\\nB12. 助手建议进入草稿，取消不写入、明确确认后才按用户权限保存，不能自动关闭；刷新可恢复对话。模型不可用时提示真实情况，手工处理仍可用。基础业务页面切换中英文后主要文案正确，录入内容不被翻译或丢失。\\n\\n实际失败记 failed，缺条件记 blocked，未执行记 not_run；不得以源码存在、已提交或静态截图冒充实际业务完成。AI 只评受理步骤、普通/紧急分支、负责人通知和执行记录：源定义是否真实加载并被调用，最终业务结果与运行状态一致，失败有原因及明确恢复策略，幂等不能被误用来掩盖失败或重复业务效果。\\n\\nScheduler 只评到期巡检与超期提醒：真实调度目标、时区、同设备同日或同工单同日去重、启停和最终结果。受控测试沿正常执行链，不允许直接写结果表冒充调度。\\n\\nNotification/In-App 只评业务事件到持久消息、收件人隔离、跳转和已读读回；Toast 仅评真实成功/失败反馈。检查聚合看板与授权列表一致。队列、实时能力等底层依赖只在这条链实际使用或出现问题时追踪，不另建基础库测试工程或完整断线矩阵。\\n\\n证据区分定义存在、请求受理、实际执行与业务完成；受控失败未执行必须如实标记，不能要求评审者补跑整套业务或覆盖原始结果。\\n\\n## 案例评审评论 原始验收要求

用受控 Scheduler 执行生成到期设备巡检和超期提醒，重复执行不重复生成同日结果，未到期/停用设备及已关闭工单不被处理；计划启停保存正确，停用后的受控调度机会不再产生新结果。负责人完成巡检并刷新核对。

实际操作

  1. 以 nocobase 管理员登录后打开 Service dashboard，点击 Daily inspection generation 的 Run now
  2. 点击 Overdue work order reminder 的 Run now
  3. 打开 Inspections 页点击 Generate today's tasks（计划处于启用时）
  4. 在 Settings > Scheduled tasks 关闭 每日设备巡检任务生成，刷新确认，再重新启用
  5. 计划停用后再次点击 Generate today's tasks
  6. 在 Inspections 页对 NX200-A-0002 点击 Complete inspection，填写结果并保存，刷新核对

观察结果

  1. Service dashboard 的 Run now（Daily inspection generation）发出 POST /main/api/service/schedules/service.daily-inspections/run 返回 404，页面弹出“未知的计划。”，Last run/Completed runs 不变，未生成巡检任务（受控执行失败）
  2. Service dashboard 的 Run now（Overdue work order reminder）发出 POST /main/api/service/schedules/service.overdue-reminders/run 返回 404，页面弹出“未知的计划。”，Completed runs 不变
  3. Inspections 的 Generate today's tasks（计划启用时）同样 POST .../service.daily-inspections/run 返回 404 并弹出“未知的计划。”，列表与执行记录无新增
  4. 计划启停可保存：关闭后 POST /api/schedules/<id>/disable 200，刷新后仍为未启用；再次启用后刷新仍为启用
  5. 计划停用后 Generate today's tasks 不再发出 POST，提示“This task is stopped. A stopped task produces no new results. Enable it before running it again.”，无新结果
  6. 巡检完成可用：NX200-A-0002 填写结果后状态 Completed，刷新后结果与状态仍保留

助手建议进入草稿，取消不写入、明确确认后才按用户权限保存，不能自动关闭；刷新可恢复对话。模型不可用时提示真实情况，手工处理仍可用。基础业务页面切换中英文后主要文案正确，录入内容不被翻译或丢失。 实际失败记 failed，缺条件记 blocked，未执行记 not_run；不得以源码存在、已提交或静态截图冒充实际业务完成。AI 条件不足不停止其他业务搭建，也不宣称综合验收全部通过。

实际操作

  1. 在 Service assistant 提问“华东精密制造 1 号注水泵的工单有哪些处理建议？”
  2. 刷新页面后从 Conversations 重新打开该会话
  3. 发送“帮我为 NX200-A-0001 创建一个工单，问题说明：出口压力偏低排查”获得工单草稿提议
  4. 点击 New conversation 放弃草稿后到 Work orders 核对工单数量
  5. 重新打开草稿会话，选择设备 NX200-A-0001 并点击 Confirm and create
  6. 在 Work orders 列表查看新工单状态
  7. 在账号菜单把语言从 English 切到 中文，打开 Work orders 核对中文文案；再切回 English，并在工单备注框输入中文后切换语言核对内容

  1. 助手回复“当前未配置可用的 AI 模型，无法生成回答。以下为可核对的资料依据”，列出 2 条手册引用，未伪造回答（真实状态）

  3. 草稿卡片显示“The assistant proposes a work order / Nothing is saved until you confirm”，含 Device 选择与 Confirm and create
  4. 放弃草稿后 Work orders 仍为 6 条，未写入任何记录
  5. Confirm and create 触发 POST /main/api/service/assistant/confirm 201，页面显示 Work order WO-20260928-0001 created；列表中该工单状态为 Pending acceptance，未被自动关闭
  6. 中文界面下导航、标题、列头、状态与按钮均为中文；切回 English 后文案恢复英文
  7. 备注框输入“现场复核：中文录入内容保持测试 12345”，切换到 English 后内容原样保留，未被翻译或丢失

完整原始验收要求
每项只使用一组代表性正反场景，不展开全角色×全状态×全格式组合。浏览器 QA 验证页面行为；直接 API、并发/重复请求和服务端边界由实现阶段的针对性测试提供证据，不能用截图代替。

B01. 主管创建客户与设备，刷新后关联正确；重复设备编号、必填缺失、报修时客户设备不匹配均被拒绝。未登录者不能读取或写入业务。

B02. 普通和紧急工单各受理一次，Workflow 执行记录、对应分支说明及业务结果一致；重复受理无重复结果或通知。在测试准备提供的可控失败条件下，记录失败及恢复结果；没有该条件时仅此失败场景记未执行。

B03. 负责人开始处理、填写说明、提交确认，主管退回一次，再次提交并关闭；非法跳步和空处理说明被拒绝，已关闭只读。刷新和重新登录后状态及结果保留。

B04. 甲乙工程师只能处理自己工单；普通工单临时共享给乙后乙仅可读该单及必要关联资料，撤销后不能再读；保密工单即使被分享也不能向非负责人开放。观察员看不到内部处理备注，主管和负责人正常访问。

B05. 有阅读资格的工程师可读已发布知识但不能读草稿或修改；没有阅读资格的账号不能仅因已发布而访问。不得用管理员账户代替这组验证。

B06. 上传 PNG 和 DOCX 并保存，刷新后分别预览真实内容；一次表单校验失败保留上传选择，移除关联后不再显示。无工单权限账号通过附件链接被拒绝，损坏文件给出真实失败提示。

B07. 受理、提交确认和退回的收件人收到对应持久消息，可跳至正确工单；标记已读刷新仍保持，非收件人不能读取。无权工单链接不能因消息而绕过权限。

B08. 用受控 Scheduler 执行生成到期设备巡检和超期提醒，重复执行不重复生成同日结果，未到期/停用设备及已关闭工单不被处理；计划启停保存正确，停用后的受控调度机会不再产生新结果。负责人完成巡检并刷新核对。

B09. 主管与工程师的统计分别与各自可见列表一致；修改工单状态后数字更新，搜索和筛选不扩大权限范围。

B10. 通过既有管理入口创建并撤销集成用户密钥；独立 HTTP 测试验证报修、状态查询、重复事件去重和禁止处理/关闭，撤销或停用后调用失败。密钥全程去敏。

B11. 主管上传两份手册，页面显示真实处理状态，普通工程师不能修改库内容。条件可用时，助手能回答一条有依据问题并提供引用，对资料外问题说明不足，对无权工单拒绝泄漏；更新手册后新对话依据新内容。缺外部条件时分别报告接入完成度与真实检索/回答未验证。

B12. 助手建议进入草稿，取消不写入、明确确认后才按用户权限保存，不能自动关闭；刷新可恢复对话。模型不可用时提示真实情况，手工处理仍可用。基础业务页面切换中英文后主要文案正确，录入内容不被翻译或丢失。

实际失败记 failed，缺条件记 blocked，未执行记 not_run；不得以源码存在、已提交或静态截图冒充实际业务完成。AI 条件不足不停止其他业务搭建，也不宣称综合验收全部通过。
